event.text: Index on orders(customer_id, created_at) makes the subquery fast. Also expression index on date_trunc won't work (timestamptz date_trunc not immutable). Partial/amount index could help.

Missing index on orders.customer_id is causing a sequential scan per outer row in that correlated subquery, which Postgres won't decorrelate on its own—that's the real source of the 17s runtime. Since settings alone won't fix this, I'm wondering if increasing parallel workers could help, since parallel-safe subplans can execute across workers, so I want to check the plan quickly to confirm.

I'm considering indexing orders by customer_id and created_at to speed up the date-range filter, and double-checking how date_trunc interacts with timezone settings when comparing against a plain date cast to timestamptz.
